Name: Mattaniah, Son of Asaph
Summary: Mattaniah, of the sons of Asaph, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Zechariah, Son of Asaph; King Hezekiah; Asaph
LifeLesson: Singers and cleansers were the same Levites.
